advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.root.d: Touch the ruins beneath the waves. Obtain a Vent Crab Shell.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.enter_: Wade into the sunlit shallows of the Deep Reach.
Descend into the Twilight Caverns, where daylight finally fails.
Reach the crushing dark of the Abyssal Rifts.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.craft_: Craft a Shoal Suit from glass, copper, and vent-crab plating.
Upgrade to a Diver's Rig, armored with iron.
Forge an Abyssal Exosuit from abyssal stone.
Craft a Rebreather to stretch every precious breath.
Build a Dive Tool for cutting wrecks and clearing grates.
Assemble a Remora Submersible for long-range underwater travel.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.build_: Place a Habitat block to anchor a settlement in the deep.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.kill_t: Put down a Twilight Stalker that haunts the cavern mouths.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.kill_h: Destroy a Hadal Wraith and silence the deepest darkness.
mission.echodeepreachprotocol.secure_fir: Anchor the first pressurized shelter in the Shoals. Place a thermal vent frame and secure a pressure suit before the tide shifts.
mission.echodeepreachprotocol.craft_firs: A pressure suit is the difference between a dive and a death sentence. Craft or recover any diving-rated suit before pushing deeper.
mission.echodeepreachprotocol.survey_twi: Map the cavern threshold where the last daylight fades. Clear stalkers from a vent site and establish a forward light marker.
mission.echodeepreachprotocol.recover_la: The Lattice archives hold pre-collapse deep-reach telemetry. Locate an archive structure and extract a crystal sample before the sentinels lock it down.
mission.echodeepreachprotocol.reach_hada: The campaign's deepest boundary lies in the Hadal Trenches. Survive the pressure, find the wraith that hunts the trench floor, and end it.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.enter_: Cross into the resonant crystal fields of the Lattice.
Descend into the crushing Hadal Trenches.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.craft_: Craft a Lattice Void Suit by bonding an Abyssal Exosuit with resonant crystal.
Forge a Hadal Hardsuit capable of surviving the deepest trenches.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.kill_l: Destroy a Lattice Sentinel guarding the crystal fields.
advancement.echodeepreachprotocol.build_: Place a Submersible Dock to berth and maintain underwater vehicles.
Place a Xenobiologist Lab to study the creatures of the deep.
mission.echodeepreachprotocol.enter_the_: The Lattice hums beneath the Abyssal Rifts. Cross into its resonant biome and clear the sentinels that guard the crystal fields.
mission.echodeepreachprotocol.conquer_ha: No depth is unreachable with the right armor. Descend to the Hadal Trenches, end the wraith that rules them, and forge a Hadal Hardsuit worthy of the abyss.
